name: PantryPal
one_liner: Snap a photo of your fridge to get three recipes you can cook right away.
problem: Deciding what to cook based on what you already have in your fridge can be difficult and time-consuming.
audience: Home cooks looking for quick recipe ideas based on the ingredients they have on hand.

features.name: Ingredient detection from fridge photo
features.description: Take a photo of your open fridge using the camera button to automatically detect visible ingredients.

features.name: Ranked recipe suggestions
features.description: View three suggested recipes ranked by how many of your detected ingredients they use.

features.name: Missing ingredients shopping list
features.description: Generate a shopping list containing the missing items required to make suggested recipes.
